title: Brownfield: fix security defects and add expiry + analytics to the v1 service
description: An existing v1 codebase (seeded with defects the agents are NOT told about). The analyst scans the code, reproduces the defects with a failing test, maps the impact on existing modules, then applies a change-controlled patch plus two new slices. Modifying security-sensitive files needs human approval; a bad patch is rolled back and retried.
requirementText: We run the URL shortener v1 in production. A security review found that it accepts javascript: and file: links and internal addresses, and that short codes are generated with Math.Random so they are predictable - fix these and block dangerous URL schemes. In addition, add link expiry (TTL) and click analytics with referrers. Existing links and APIs must keep working.
